subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw support MiniMax Token Plan media and office flows in core by changing provider routing or sub-agent skill visibility, or keep the current dedicated endpoint plus AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md sub-agent boundary and route Token Plan office workflows through skills, ClawHub, or mmx CLI docs?
rationale: The source proves the current behavior the issue complains about, but deciding whether to alter endpoint contracts or sub-agent bootstrap inheritance is a product and compatibility choice that live Token Plan proof alone cannot settle.

options.title: Live-verify provider/media first
options.body: Confirm the Token Plan image endpoint and sub-agent media completion behavior with redacted live proof, then fix only the confirmed provider or media gap while preserving the bootstrap boundary by default.

options.title: Approve scoped Token Plan skill surface
options.body: Define a narrow plugin or bundled-skill contract for Token Plan office workflows if maintainers want this supported as an OpenClaw-owned surface.

options.title: Keep boundary and document workaround
options.body: Leave image generation on the dedicated endpoint and publish the mmx CLI or ClawHub skill path as the supported Token Plan workflow unless new evidence proves core behavior is broken.

recommendation.title: Live-verify provider/media first
recommendation.body: Confirm the Token Plan image endpoint and sub-agent media completion behavior with redacted live proof, then fix only the confirmed provider or media gap while preserving the bootstrap boundary by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This spans current provider, skills, and sub-agent policy rather than one local bug path, and Peter is the best available cross-area history signal in this checkout.
